scope.zh: 已核对触发、选项与结局；但编译器无法从隐藏入口的结果中剔除 bio.3400，图中多出一个不会出现在此路径上的文档。
scope.en: Trigger, options and outcomes checked; but the compiler cannot drop bio.3400 from a hidden entry's outcomes, so the tree shows one document that never occurs on this path.

uncertain: Unity bio.3400 is only sent when the Control fragment awakens (fallen_empire_awakening_events.txt:456-475), while this path awakens the War fragment, so it does not occur here; needs compiler support for suppressing hidden-entry outcomes.
